propositions: AGENTS.md currently claims LSP symbol tools are unconditionally preferable to grep for finding references, but this claim is false for symbols referenced via string literals like monkeypatch.setattr
LSP tools cannot resolve symbol names passed as string arguments to functions like monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, or importlib, creating blind spots that grep would catch
LSP index staleness can cause reported line numbers to lag behind recent edits in the working tree, making grep on the current tree more reliable for line numbers
The current overstated preference trains agents to discount the rule, which may have contributed to missing string-literal call sites in practice
A decision table dividing labor by use case (semantic reference finding via Serena, string-literal finding via grep, current line numbers via grep) will make the rule safely applicable
